titulo: LibreOffice says ‘no AI’ is now a software feature
resumo_original: The maker of the open source document editor says it has no plans to add AI to its software's default configuration, citing user privacy.

titulo: Vinod Khosla believes ex-DeepMind engineer’s Wajo will win agent market on trust
resumo_original: Wajo's Fo agent can hire humans to complete a task.

titulo: Bluesky wants to give you your own domain on the open web
resumo_original: Bluesky says the process will still take 18-24 months, so don't expect your new, shortened 'bsky' handle any time soon.

titulo: Emmys will move from broadcast TV to Prime Video in 2027

titulo: All-electric camping gets a solar upgrade: The 2027 Pebble Flow
